name: Sanguine Essence keeps the weapons drawn (#7008)
contract: Sanguine Essence 680692 is a mortal-ability form: it grants abilities but does not transform the Bloodmage, who
stays in human form until the aura is cancelled. The cursed-form weapon hiding (AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp,
UpdateCursedFormWeapons and the visible-item hook) treated every spell in the CursedForms list alike, and 680692 is on
it, so casting it cleared the visible main hand, off hand and ranged items while the stats stayed. The two
mortal-ability forms (680692 and 801076) no longer hide weapons; the real transforming forms still do, and restore
the weapons when they end. A level 20 Bloodmage with a worn shortsword casts Sanguine Essence: the item other
clients are told to draw in the main hand must stay. A transforming form (562572) set on the Bloodmage replaces it and
must hide the sword; when that form ends the sword is drawn again.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
SETUP: other clients are told to draw the sword
DISCRIMINATING: the sword is still drawn under Sanguine Essence
A transforming cursed form still hides the sword
The sword is back when the transforming form ends
